## 连续时间信号的采样

Sampling loses information, different signals may have same samples

- $x_{1}(t)=\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{3} t\right), x_{2}(t)=\cos \left(\frac{7 \pi}{3} t\right)$, different
- $x_{1}[n]=\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{3} n\right)=x_{2}[n]=\cos \left(\frac{7 \pi}{3} n\right)$, identical
![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/5064b8cb-9152-49e8-a068-28861005f52f-04.jpg?height=401&width=988&top_left_y=412&top_left_x=135)

Under what conditions can we recover signal from samples?

## 冲激列采样

时域

CT signal $x(t)$
![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/5064b8cb-9152-49e8-a068-28861005f52f-05.jpg?height=229&width=697&top_left_y=153&top_left_x=508)
impulse train

$$
\begin{aligned}
& p(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} \delta(t-n T) \\

& =\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) \delta(t-n T)
\end{aligned}
$$

![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/5064b8cb-9152-49e8-a068-28861005f52f-05.jpg?height=172&width=697&top_left_y=430&top_left_x=508)

## 冲激列采样

频域
CT signal $X(j \omega)$
![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/5064b8cb-9152-49e8-a068-28861005f52f-06.jpg?height=256&width=582&top_left_y=102&top_left_x=645)
impulse train

$$
\begin{aligned}
& P(j \omega)=\omega_{s} \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \delta\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right) \\
& X_{p}(j \omega)=\frac{1}{2 \pi}(X * P)(\omega) \\
& =\frac{1}{T} \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} X\left(j\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right)\right)
\end{aligned}
$$

![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/5064b8cb-9152-49e8-a068-28861005f52f-06.jpg?height=279&width=584&top_left_y=403&top_left_x=643)

## 冲激列采样

频域
band-limited CT signal
$X(j \omega)=0$ for $|\omega|>\omega_{M}$
![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/5064b8cb-9152-49e8-a068-28861005f52f-07.jpg?height=282&width=574&top_left_y=102&top_left_x=645)

Case 1: $\omega_{s}>2 \omega_{M}$ no overlap between replicas can recover $X$ by lowpass filtering
![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/5064b8cb-9152-49e8-a068-28861005f52f-07.jpg?height=256&width=576&top_left_y=470&top_left_x=643)

Case 2: $\omega_{s}<2 \omega_{M}$ replicas overlap cannot recover $X$
![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/5064b8cb-9152-49e8-a068-28861005f52f-07.jpg?height=207&width=578&top_left_y=732&top_left_x=643)

## 采样定理

Band-limited CT signal $x(t)$ whose spectrum $X(j \omega)=0$ for $|\omega|>\omega_{M}$ is uniquely determined by its samples $x(n T), n \in \mathbb{Z}$ if

$$
\omega_{s} \triangleq \frac{2 \pi}{T}>2 \omega_{M}, \quad 2 \omega_{M} \text { called Nyquist rate }
$$

Given $\{x(n T): n \in \mathbb{Z}\}, x(t)$ can be reconstructed as follows

1. construct $x_{p}(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) \delta(t-n T)$
2. send $x_{p}$ through lowpass filter with gain $T$ and cutoff frequency $\omega_{c} \in\left(\omega_{M}, \omega_{s}-\omega_{M}\right)$, i.e.

$$
H(j \omega)=T\left[u\left(\omega+\omega_{c}\right)-u\left(\omega-\omega_{c}\right)\right]
$$

3. filter output $x_{r}(t)$ with $X_{r}(j \omega)=X_{p}(j \omega) H(j \omega)$ is same as $x(t)$

## 频域中的重建

![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/5064b8cb-9152-49e8-a068-28861005f52f-09.jpg?height=139&width=658&top_left_y=159&top_left_x=64)

$$
p(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} \delta(t-n T)
$$

- Nyquist frequency $\omega_{M}$
- Nyquist rate $2 \omega_{M}$

Lowpass filter

- gain $T$
- cutoff frequency

$$
\omega_{M}<\omega_{c}<\omega_{s}-\omega_{M}
$$

![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/5064b8cb-9152-49e8-a068-28861005f52f-09.jpg?height=452&width=481&top_left_y=99&top_left_x=738)
![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/5064b8cb-9152-49e8-a068-28861005f52f-09.jpg?height=354&width=578&top_left_y=372&top_left_x=643)

## 时域中的重建

$$
x(t) \xrightarrow{\phi} x_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} \delta(t-n T)
$$

Impulse response of lowpass filter

$$
h(t)=\frac{T \sin \left(\omega_{c} t\right)}{\pi t}
$$

$x$ recovered by band-limited interpolation using sinc function

$$
x(t)=x_{r}(t)=\left(x_{p} * h\right)(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) \frac{T \sin \left(\omega_{c}(t-n T)\right)}{\pi(t-n T)}
$$

## 时域中的重建

![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/5064b8cb-9152-49e8-a068-28861005f52f-11.jpg?height=350&width=1155&top_left_y=123&top_left_x=42)

$$
\omega_{c}=\frac{\omega_{s}}{2}=\frac{\pi}{T}
$$

![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/5064b8cb-9152-49e8-a068-28861005f52f-11.jpg?height=360&width=1158&top_left_y=581&top_left_x=40)

## 时域中的重建

Setting $\omega_{c}=\frac{\omega_{s}}{2}$ yields Whittaker-Shannon interpolation formula

$$
x_{r}(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) \operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-n T}{T}\right), \quad \text { where } \operatorname{sinc}(t)=\frac{\sin (\pi t)}{\pi t}
$$

Since

$$
\operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-n T}{T}\right) \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} T e^{-j n T \omega}\left[u\left(\omega+\frac{\pi}{T}\right)-u\left(\omega-\frac{\pi}{T}\right)\right]
$$

Parseval's identity (or multiplication property) implies

$$
\int_{\mathbb{R}} \operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-n T}{T}\right) \operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-m T}{T}\right) d t=\frac{T^{2}}{2 \pi} \int_{-\frac{\pi}{T}}^{\frac{\pi}{T}} e^{j(m-n) T \omega} d \omega=T \delta[n-m]
$$

Whittaker-Shannon formula is orthogonal expansion

## 时域中的重建

![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/5064b8cb-9152-49e8-a068-28861005f52f-13.jpg?height=350&width=1155&top_left_y=123&top_left_x=42)

$$
\omega_{c}=\frac{\omega_{s}}{4}=\frac{\pi}{2 T}>\omega_{M}
$$

![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/5064b8cb-9152-49e8-a068-28861005f52f-13.jpg?height=328&width=1155&top_left_y=590&top_left_x=42)

![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/5064b8cb-9152-49e8-a068-28861005f52f-14.jpg?height=350&width=1155&top_left_y=123&top_left_x=42)

$$
\omega_{c}=\frac{3 \omega_{s}}{5}<\omega_{s}-\omega_{M}
$$

## 零阶保持

$$
x(t) \xrightarrow{p(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} \delta(t-n T)} \frac{x_{p}(t)}{{ }_{0}^{\mid h_{0}(t)} t} \text { → } x_{0}(t)
$$

Reconstructed signal

$$
x_{0}(t)=\left(x_{p} * h_{0}\right)(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) h_{0}(t-n T)
$$

Zero-order hold filter

$$
H_{0}(j \omega)=e^{-j \omega T / 2} \frac{2 \sin (\omega T / 2)}{\omega}
$$

![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/5064b8cb-9152-49e8-a068-28861005f52f-17.jpg?height=334&width=624&top_left_y=570&top_left_x=598)

## 零阶保持

![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/5064b8cb-9152-49e8-a068-28861005f52f-18.jpg?height=355&width=1209&top_left_y=123&top_left_x=27)
![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/5064b8cb-9152-49e8-a068-28861005f52f-18.jpg?height=348&width=1201&top_left_y=568&top_left_x=30)

## 线性插值 (First-order Hold)

$$
x(t) \xrightarrow{p(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} \delta(t-n T)} x_{p}(t) \longrightarrow x_{0}(t)
$$

Reconstructed signal

$$
x_{1}(t)=\left(x_{p} * h_{1}\right)(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) h_{1}(t-n T)
$$

First-order hold filter

$$
H_{1}(j \omega)=\frac{1}{T}\left[\frac{\sin (\omega T / 2)}{\omega / 2}\right]^{2}
$$

![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/5064b8cb-9152-49e8-a068-28861005f52f-19.jpg?height=332&width=518&top_left_y=585&top_left_x=718)
